mike: starting staged rollout to eu-west-1 -> v2.3.1 at 14:20 UTC, target 10%. /deploybot start --percent=10 --region=eu-west-1 --version=v2.3.1

deploy-bot: Started staged rollout (id=1792223333) target=10% region=eu-west-1 version=v2.3.1 monitors=ops-dash

dana: seeing an uptick in 5xxs ~14:23 UTC, digging logs

leo: can we slow to 5% while we confirm kv-cache warmup behavior?

mike: hold on roll to 5% pending ops signal

sre-oncall: telemetry: p90 eu-west increased 200ms->350ms, 5xx rate 0.6%->3.1% in last 4m. flagging

irene: QA repro: NPE in embedding preproc on long prompts (sample 992). stack shows NullPointer at Preproc.java:112

dana: logs -> https://logs.re/redwood/abc123 ids: 987,992. embeddingPreprocessor failing on certain inputs

eva: note: v2.3.1 changed embedded payload schema (small tweak). will prepare release-note snippet and patch branch

leo: my vote: pause rollout + targeted rollback for eu-west to v2.3.0

eva: agree rollback eu-west only, QA signoff before re-rollout

sre-oncall: ops recommends targeted eu rollback, no signals in other regions

mike: executing region rollback command:
```
/deploybot rollback --region=eu-west-1 --to-version=v2.3.0 --reason="5xx spike + NPEs" --thread=1792223333
```

deploy-bot: Rolling back eu-west-1 -> v2.3.0. initiating drain and cutover. ETA ~2m

dana: monitoring logs and metrics during cutover

leo: after rollback, propose slow canary 5% with kv_cache=false and expanded eval set for embeddings

eva: opening ticket RTM-4321 for embedding preproc fix, linking PR and release notes

dana: rollback complete. eu-west now on v2.3.0, 5xxs and latency back to baseline :white_check_mark:

mike: summary: stopped v2.3.1 eu rollout, targeted rollback applied. follow-ups: RTM-4321 (postmortem + fix), new ramp plan with kv_cache toggle. I'll post to #postmortems and update release notes :thumbsup:
